contexts.text: The migration of Jacob and his sons into Egypt, represented the Lord's first instruction...
For sojourning and migration... in Heaven is nothing but change of state.
Because they have removed away from thee (): their removal = deprivation.
So long as man lives in the world, he migrates from one Society into another...
To remove from the place... () represented... the rejection (of the truths of doctrine): the vessels for removal = the truths of doctrine.
